title: DU-Shapley: A Shapley Value Proxy for Efficient Dataset Valuation
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not contain any benchmarks that measure aspects of faith or religion. The evaluations focus on machine learning model performance (e.g., accuracy, MSE, F1-score) in classification and regression tasks.
findings: This paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith; its focus is on a technical machine learning problem (dataset valuation) and contains no findings related to religion.
